{{Quote|Yes, I still have it. After all, I had trained for all those years. Why should I give it up like a thief, when I deserve to carry it?"<br />"Because you deserve it no longer. You shame it.|Xanatos and Qui-Gon Jinn, on the subject of the former's lightsaber|<ref name="JATDR" />}}
When he was selected by the esteemed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] to become his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] trainee [[Xanatos]] constructed a '''lightsaber''' which he wielded for the entirety of his life both as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. Xanatos used a [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] for his blade before turning to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], replacing the original crystal with a [[Synthetic lightsaber crystal/Legends|synthetic red one]].

Xanatos used the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] on worlds such as [[Telos IV]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] where he usually crossed blades with his former master Jinn and his newly selected apprentice [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. He used this on Bandomeer to duel his former mentor and then a second time against Jinn and his apprentice Kenobi.

He would later use this again on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when he sabotaged the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and used it in a duel with his former mentor while his Dark Jedi apprentice [[Bruck Chun]] dueled Kenobi. Xanatos would later escape the Temple and Coruscant.

When Xanatos was cornered by the two Jedi on his home world of Telos in a confrontation, he committed suicide and jumped into a pool of acid along with his red lightsaber which was destroyed along with him.
